text_block_list.text:
Called over by Grass Wonder, I ended up 
watching her dance.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much taking the trouble to 
come all the way out here."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
... Could we go over that last part once 
more—

Grass Wonder was earnestly practicing her 
dancing, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew...

Having finished her dance, Grass Wonder 
let out a quiet sigh with a troubled look 
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The steps during the chorus just don't 
feel right...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The rhythm and tempo should be perfect, 
and yet I feel like I'm not dancing like 
the other girls...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Why not try putting your feelings out in 
the open?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Perhaps I was placing too much 
emphasis on graceful, delicate movements.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Powerfully, and rhythmically...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For the chorus, instead of a dance, I'll 
try imagining it as a martial arts 
demonstration~.

Adding power to the dance seemed to give a 
tangible sense of progress.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That is certainly an important point.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I was too bound by the idea of 
modesty."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just like in a race where you pour out 
your heart for victory, the Winning Live 
is no different...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will pour feelings into my dance that 
are as strong as anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I might end up being a little bolder 
than usual~.

Grass Wonder began practicing her dancing 
with far more liveliness than before.
